title: Going back from an invoice keeps the Sales Type selection
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A and sales rep B, so that the work order can have a different Labor and Parts representative.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Have at least one split work order invoiced today with Labor set to sales rep A and Parts set to sales rep B, so the Parts filter leaves only sales rep B's row.
  • Open Reports > Sales By Representative in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide, with the date range set to today and Show Unassigned on.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Select only "Parts" in the Sales Type filter.
  2. Expand sales rep B.
  3. Open the invoice from sales rep B's row.
  4. Press the browser's back button.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The filter reads "Sales Type: Parts".

Step 2:

  • Sales rep B's invoice rows show.

Step 3:

  • The invoice opens.

Step 4:

  • The report returns without a full reload.
  • "Sales Type: Parts" is still selected.
  • Sales rep B is still expanded.
  • The scroll position is the same.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: "SBR (Sales By Representative) Report" spec, Confluence 585629698, version 28 (12 Oct 2026), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11272 (Story 8, Filter both sales reports by Sales Type)

  • Sales By Representative spec, S12-R3a: “Pressing the browser back button from either destination returns the user to the report with all state intact — date range, sales type, invoice status, location, Show Unassigned, every rep's expansion state, and scroll position — exactly as they were. Back-navigation must not trigger a full report reload. (This differs from a deliberate page reload, which restores the persisted filters/columns/sort but resets expansion and scroll — Story 23.)”
